doc.brief: Describes a type of line wrapping.
doc.md: Describes a type of line wrapping.

char.brief: wrap text, breaking lines anywhere the cursor can appear (between characters, usually - if you want to be technical, between graphemes, see pango_get_log_attrs())
char.md:
wrap text, breaking lines anywhere the cursor can
  appear (between characters, usually - if you want to be technical,
  between graphemes, see pango_get_log_attrs())

none.brief: do not wrap lines; just make the text area wider
none.md: do not wrap lines; just make the text area wider

word.brief: wrap text, breaking lines in between words
word.md: wrap text, breaking lines in between words

word_char.brief: wrap text, breaking lines in between words, or if that is not enough, also between graphemes
word_char.md:
wrap text, breaking lines in between words, or if
  that is not enough, also between graphemes
